label: WHAT MOST GUYS DO
head: Snap back instantly
sub: Now you're the one who looks out of control.

label: STEP 1
head: Make him repeat it
sub: "Sorry, say that again?" Rude comments sound worse the second time.

label: STEP 2
head: Look at him and smile slightly
sub: Say nothing for 3 seconds. The silence makes him explain himself.

label: STEP 3
head: Draw one clear line
sub: "Don't talk to me like that again." Calm voice, then move on.
